statement: Training-free quality preservation under aggressive compression is not reliably achievable across tasks and models. Heuristic eviction (CAKE, SnapKV) is training-free but its gains over baselines are modest and shrink toward full-cache parity; learned methods (LKV, VQKV codebooks) need a training/distillation phase to reach near-lossless at strict budgets. There is no demonstrated training-free method that is near-lossless at very low budgets (e.g., <10%) across diverse long-context tasks and model families, so the training-free-vs-training-aware trade-off remains a live frontier rather than a settled choice.
